title: 0% APR claim lacks required qualifying disclosures
recommendation: The 0% APR claim appears without qualifying details such as the applicable term length, eligible models, and credit qualifications. Add disclosures specifying the APR term (e.g., 60 months), which vehicles qualify, and that the rate is subject to approved credit. Ensure the disclosure is proximate to the claim.

title: Lease disclaimer visual prominence cannot be verified
quote: Lease a 2026 RAM 1500 Big Horn 4x4 for $399 a month plus tax for 39 months. $4099 due at signing.
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — The automated audit cannot assess the visual layout, font size, or prominence of the lease disclaimer relative to the $399/month payment claim. Please verify that the lease terms (due at signing, mileage limits, expiration) are displayed in a font size and placement that is clear and conspicuous relative to the monthly payment amount. The due-at-signing amount should not be significantly less prominent than the monthly payment.

title: Lease due-at-signing does not itemize components
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — The $4,099 due-at-signing amount does not appear to break down its components (first month's payment, cap cost reduction, acquisition fee, etc.). While the total is disclosed, best practice is to itemize what is included. Verify whether a breakdown exists behind expandable content or on a linked offers page.

title: Sale Price and Trade-In Allowance deducted without qualification disclosures
quote: MSRP $50,580 Dealer Discount -$1,580 Sale Price $49,000 Trade In Allowance -$1,000 Net Price $48,000
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — The VDP shows a 'Trade In Allowance' of -$1,000 deducted to reach a 'Net Price' of $48,000. This conditional discount assumes a trade-in, which not all consumers will have. Verify that the page includes a disclaimer clarifying that the Net Price requires a qualifying trade-in. Also verify that 'Sale Price' language has associated sale dates or expiration, as perpetual sale pricing without dates may violate B&P Code 17501.

title: Sale/savings pricing on VLP without visible sale dates
quote: MSRP, Dealer Discount, Sale Price, Trade In Allowance, Net Price shown
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — The automated audit could not confirm whether sale start/end dates are present on the vehicle listing page. The extracted text references 'Sale Price' and 'Dealer Discount' language across 63 vehicles. Please verify that sale pricing includes expiration dates and that Trade In Allowance deductions include a qualifying disclaimer.

title: No reference to 3-day cancellation right on used vehicle pages
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — The CARS Act (SB 766, effective October 1, 2026) grants a 3-day cancellation right for used vehicles priced at $50,000 or less. No reference to this right was found on the used vehicle inventory page. While the law is not yet in effect and the primary disclosure occurs at point of sale, consider adding a reference to the cancellation right on used vehicle pages ahead of the October 1 effective date as a best practice.

title: 0% APR promotional claim in page title without disclaimer
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — The VLP page title contains 'Finance for 0% APR For 60 months*' as a promotional claim. The asterisk suggests a disclaimer exists, but no corresponding disclaimer text was captured on the VLP. Stellantis DAP guidelines require all offers to include required disclaimers. Verify that the asterisk links to or is accompanied by qualifying terms (credit qualifications, eligible models, offer expiration).
